emp-001.description: Out of memory during inference batch processing
emp-001.self_heal_action: Reduced batch size 64→32, cleared GPU cache
emp-001.root_cause_analysis: Batch size exceeded available VRAM during concurrent model loading

emp-003.description: Recursive dependency resolution exceeded stack limit
emp-003.root_cause_analysis: Circular dependency in task graph not detected by validator

emp-004.description: Schema validation timed out on large OpenAPI spec
emp-004.self_heal_action: Switched to streaming validator, increased timeout to 30s
emp-004.root_cause_analysis: Synchronous validation on 5000+ line spec exceeded 10s default timeout

emp-004.description: Lost connection to Figma API during design export
emp-004.root_cause_analysis: Transient network issue during peak API usage

emp-010.description: PostgreSQL advisory lock acquisition timed out during migration
emp-010.self_heal_action: Released stale locks, retried migration with shorter transaction scope
emp-010.root_cause_analysis: Long-running transaction held advisory lock beyond expected duration
